notes:
What's new in EnigmaCast

The left menu now follows your chosen theme, with new fonts, and is a little slimmer so more of the screen is left for TV.

The on-screen controls in the video player also follow your theme, including when you watch films and series.

The IPTV provider screen now fits on one page, so you no longer need to scroll to see everything.

You can download IPTV movies and episodes to this TV and watch them later without a connection. Find them under My Items > Downloads. Your watch progress is synced when you are back home.

New installations start with smoother, faster display settings. Existing TVs keep the settings you already chose.

This release also includes stability fixes, including more reliable downloads and a fix for My Items.

companion.notes: Live koppelt nu automatisch met de Enigma2-ontvanger van de TV. Nieuw: Zoeken en een Torrents-tab als die op de TV aanstaat.
